# Image de production du backend Django (gunicorn, sans dependances de dev).
FROM python:3.12-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
    DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.prod

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Certificats racine d'entreprise (proxy d'inspection TLS). Dossier
# eventuellement vide : voir certs/README.md.
COPY --from=certs . /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
RUN find /usr/local/share/ca-certificates -type f ! -name "*.crt" -delete \
    && update-ca-certificates

ENV SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    PIP_CERT=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

# Fichiers statiques de l'admin. La cle ci-dessous est factice et ne sert qu'a
# cette commande de build : elle n'est pas conservee dans l'image finale.
RUN DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=build-only-not-a-secret python manage.py collectstatic --noinput \
    && chmod +x /app/entrypoint.sh \
    && useradd --system --no-create-home app \
    && chown -R app /app/staticfiles

USER app

EXPOSE 8000

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["gunicorn", "config.wsgi:application", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8000", "--workers", "3", "--access-logfile", "-"]

name: blueprint-academy-prod

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-blueprint}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-blueprint}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD est obligatoire}
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-blueprint} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-blueprint}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod
      additional_contexts:
        certs: ./certs
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: config.settings.prod
      DJANGO_DEBUG: "false"
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ${DJANGO_SECRET_KEY:?DJANGO_SECRET_KEY est obligatoire}
      DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-localhost,127.0.0.1}
      # Sans HTTPS devant (hors perimetre), la redirection est coupee ; a remettre a true derriere un proxy TLS.
      DJANGO_SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT: ${DJANGO_SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT:-false}
      CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:3000}
      CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: ${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-}
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-blueprint}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-blueprint}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD est obligatoire}
    ports:
      - "${BACKEND_HOST_PORT:-8000}:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/api/health/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod
      additional_contexts:
        certs: ./certs
      args:
        NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:-http://localhost:8000/api}
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      # Vu depuis le conteneur (server components).
      INTERNAL_API_URL: http://backend:8000/api
    ports:
      - "${FRONTEND_HOST_PORT:-3000}:3000"
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy

# Image de production du backend Django (gunicorn, sans dependances de dev).
FROM python:3.12-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
    DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.prod

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Certificats racine d'entreprise (proxy d'inspection TLS). Dossier
# eventuellement vide : voir certs/README.md.
COPY --from=certs . /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
RUN find /usr/local/share/ca-certificates -type f ! -name "*.crt" -delete \
    && update-ca-certificates

ENV SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    PIP_CERT=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

# Fichiers statiques de l'admin. La cle ci-dessous est factice et ne sert qu'a
# cette commande de build : elle n'est pas conservee dans l'image finale.
RUN DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=build-only-not-a-secret python manage.py collectstatic --noinput \
    && chmod +x /app/entrypoint.sh \
    && useradd --system --no-create-home app \
    && chown -R app /app/staticfiles

USER app

EXPOSE 8000

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["gunicorn", "config.wsgi:application", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8000", "--workers", "3", "--access-logfile", "-"]

# Image de production du frontend Next.js (build puis next start, sortie standalone).
FROM node:22-alpine AS base

ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

# Certificats racine d'entreprise (proxy d'inspection TLS). Voir certs/README.md.
COPY --from=certs . /tmp/corp-certs/
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/share/ca-certificates \
    && { cat /tmp/corp-certs/*.crt > /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corporate-ca.crt 2>/dev/null || true; } \
    && touch /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corporate-ca.crt \
    && cat /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corporate-ca.crt >> /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    && rm -rf /tmp/corp-certs

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corporate-ca.crt

FROM base AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
# Integree au bundle au moment du build (adresse de l'API vue du navigateur).
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL}
RUN npm run build

FROM base AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    PORT=3000 \
    HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/.next/static ./.next/static
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
# `next start` en mode standalone : le serveur genere par le build.
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
